messages:
Anya Rivera: ran a quick dim/batch sensitivity probe this morning for the new reranker bring-up (rdrk-v2-int8). tested dims [128,256,512], batch sizes [1,8,32,128] across us-east1 / europe-west1 / ap-southeast1 on A100 int8 path and CPU fallback on c6i. results in the sheet: https://redwood.internal/sheets/rerank-dim-batch-probe
Samir Patel: nice. did you use the continuous-batching config or fixed microbatch? any kernel overrides?
Anya Rivera: used continuous-batching=on for GPU runs, fixed microbatch (batch=1) for CPU to simulate low-latency fallbacks. kernel selection: default runtime auto-picked triton-kernel for 128/256, fell back to generic-avx for CPU. for 512 dims on gpu we tried cutlass-tuned and triton; cutlass ~5-7% faster throughput on p95 for big batches.
Maria Chen: curious about regional variance — was network or cold-start a factor in ap-southeast1?
Anya Rivera: ap-southeast1 had slightly higher cold-start p95 for CPU fallback (additional ~12ms) — likely NFS latency on model load. steady-state token generation p95 similar after warmup. GPU throughput in apac ~3% lower vs us-east (clock/PCIe differences).

Samir Patel: do we have any quality regressions from int8 quant? fp16 -> int8 evaluation on the eval set?
Anya Rivera: ran the dev-evals on the 2k prompt set. int8 (symmetric per-channel) had a small 0.6% hit on MRR for long-tail queries at dims=512; dims=256 negligible. we should flag for QA but not a blocker.
Maria Chen: what about capacity sizing recommendations? if product wants p95 < 50ms for rerank path with dims=256 and batch=32, how many GPUs per region?
Anya Rivera: rough numbers from throughput: A100-int8 at dims=256 batch=32 -> ~2300 req/s (steady). to sustain 1k rps with headroom 2.5x => need 1 GPU. but for p95 <50ms including network and proxy overhead, recommend 2 GPUs per zone for HA and headroom (or 1 GPU + CPU warm pool for burst).
Samir Patel: note on kernel choices — cutlass-tuned gave best bulk throughput but higher p95 variance for small batch sizes; triton is more stable at low batch. that matches previous findings. we should expose kernel hint in config for the rollout.
Anya Rivera: agreed. I'll add a canary config: prefer-cutlass for batch>=64, prefer-triton for batch<=8, else auto. will add to rollout PR and attach the perf plots.
Maria Chen: please also capture model load times in apac for private deployments — might need prefetching or local model cache.
Anya Rivera: yes. creating ticket in eng-platform with attachment. cc @Samir for kernel fallback policy. :thumbsup:
